description: P2 audit correction. Tests first: stale BO B/C after B/A/C reorder yields C/A/B, deterministic transaction-held reorder-vs-swap and swap-vs-stale-draft, invalid/missing/owner-change cases and existing swap contracts. comments.text: Call-site audit: only Engine PeopleGateway and BO adjacent-channel moves call swap. No tests restrict cross-owner swaps; preserve existing trusted cross-owner behavior by locking all supplied literal Person owners ascending, then channels ascending. Preserve successful return shape and update_channel activity semantics. Tests reproduce stale weights and both deterministic serialized interleavings.
